name: Laugh
overview: Scripture reveals that laughter can express both human joy and divine sovereignty. Sarah's laughter in Genesis reflects a personal response to God's surprising promises, showing that God can bring joy that causes others to rejoice as well. Conversely, Psalms portrays the Lord laughing at the plans of the wicked, demonstrating His authority and the certainty of His judgment. Thus, laughter in the Bible encompasses heartfelt rejoicing as well as God's sovereign derision of evil.
